name: Teen Volunteering and Teen Advisory Board, Plainsboro Public Library
what_you_do: Shelve books weekly, help at library programs, or join the Teen Advisory Board to plan programs, displays and teen-run events. The board meets about twice a month.
who_can_apply: Shelvers must be going into 9th grade or older. Teen Advisory Board needs an application.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Volunteer hours can be confirmed.
duration: Shelvers get one 1 hour shift a week. The Teen Advisory Board meets about twice a month.
deadline_text: Weekly volunteering registration for 2026-2027 is closed. The page says Teen Advisory Board applications open in September, at the start of each school year. Join the volunteer mailing list for new openings.
how_to_apply: Apply with the Teen Advisory Board form on the page. For volunteering, email the Teen Volunteer Coordinator and join the volunteer mailing list. Shelvers interview and train first.
notes: Selection is not first come first served.
